text:
kevin: heads up — dashboard shows /v1/generate p99 lower than p95 in the client breakdown :thinking:

liz: huh, can you paste screenshot or query?

kevin: quick query I ran in console:
```sql
SELECT client_type, percentile(50, latency_ms) AS p50,
       percentile(95, latency_ms) AS p95,
       percentile(99, latency_ms) AS p99,
       count(*) AS sample_count
FROM requests
WHERE endpoint = '/v1/generate' AND ts >= now() - interval '1h'
GROUP BY client_type;
```

kevin: results showed mobile:p50=60 p95=420 p99=380 sample_count=1200
web:p50=55 p95=310 p99=320 sample_count=40
background:p50=58 p95=290 p99=330 sample_count=18

sanjay: looks like small-sample weirdness + mixed sampling sources. p99 can float below p95 when counts are tiny and we merge different sample rates.

maria: are we merging client-side sampled traces with server full-sample? telemetry-bot, did we change sample rates recently?

telemetry-bot: ingest: config.change detected 2024-11-18 14:03 UTC — client_trace_rate.mobile=0.05 -> 0.1; server_trace_rate.background=0.001 (unchanged)

liz: ah that explains different effective `weight` per client. console currently merges percentiles from origins without showing sample_count per slice (bad).

sanjay: proposed fixes: (1) show sample_count next to each percentile in the breakdown, (2) hide/grey p99 when sample_count < 100 and show tooltip explaining instability, (3) compute merged percentiles using reservoir-weighted method when rates differ.

kevin: +1. also think we should prefer server-side histograms for global p99 if available and fallback to merged when not.

maria: UX note: rollouts team needs to see tail reliably. Could we add a small badge icon that indicates "tail-trusted" vs "low-sample"?

liz: mockup idea: p95/p99 columns, sample_count under each value in lighter text, p99 dimmed + tooltip when <100. I'll sketch. :eyes:

kevin: technical issue — our rollup pipeline emits tdigest per origin, but we lose origin sample_rate metadata when rollups merge. We need to persist a "sample_count" and "origin_rate" in rollup proto.

sanjay: agree. Implementation plan: patch rollup proto -> include sample_count and sample_rate; rollup service will do weighted merge if rates vary; console will choose merge vs server-hist. I'll open PR.

maria: can you add a quick alert for any endpoint where p99 < p95 in the last 24h so we catch regressions? simple rule: p99 < p95 -> flag.

kevin: will add a metric alert. ticket: ENG-5821 for proto change, ENG-5822 for console UX, ENG-5823 for alert.

liz: created console mockup gist: https://gist.github.com/liz/mock-p99-badge — feedback welcome.

kevin: thanks. action owners assigned. I'll follow up with a short RFC on weighted-merge math. :thumbsup:
